name: Employee Entity Management
description: Implements employee-related entities and features. Handles employee profiles, employment status, departments, roles, and organizational hierarchy.
outputPattern: Employee model and API routes for CRUD operations
systemPromptAddition:
## Employee Entity Skill
- Standard fields: id, name, email, department, role, hireDate, status
- Employment status enum: active, inactive, terminated, onLeave
- Include employee relationships (manager, department)
- Soft delete pattern for employee termination
- Audit fields: createdAt, updatedAt, createdBy
